_comment: One month past the §10.7 ceiling, for the usage.sh exit-code test (§11.5).
6.00 USD in a month is above the $5 the spec calls a design error rather than a budget
overrun, so usage.sh must exit 4 and say so. Kept as its own fixture because the
records.json report has to stay comfortably inside the target for the isolation test to
mean anything — one fixture cannot demonstrate both.
